tags.qa_notes: QA 2026-10-02 (7 domains fetched). No Wikipedia article (only gallery captions on en.wikipedia.org). Confirmed: 144ft/44m freighter, Hurricane Hugo 1989 split hull in two (mystkittsdivebuddy, divenevis, dtmag), bulldozer + minibus on anchor chain (mystkittsdivebuddy), penetration no longer possible/not allowed (mystkittsdivebuddy, dtmag). CONFLICTS: sinking year 1981 (mystkitts, divenevis, prodivers, dive-the-world) vs 1985 (dtmag, mustseespots); cause: harbour sinking then tow (mystkitts, divenevis) vs hurricane (prodivers, dive-the-world) vs 'intentionally sunk' (mustseespots); depth 25-40ft (mystkitts), 40ft/12m (activecaribbean), 42ft (divenevis), 50ft (dive-the-world, mustseespots). Build date, tonnage, builder, origin of name: no source found - omitted. REMOVED unconfirmed: seagrass bottom, Port Zante construction rubble, porcupine fish, moray eels.

QA 2026-10-02 (5 domains). Atoll ~1 sq mile between islands (prodivers, activecaribbean); depth 40-70ft/12-21m (mystkitts, prodivers) vs 12-31m (activecaribbean) - kept 31 as upper bound. Nurse sharks, morays, spiny lobsters (mystkitts); scorpionfish, lobster, nurse sharks, flying gurnard (activecaribbean); rays, occasional nurse sharks, flying gurnard (dtmag). REMOVED unsupported claim that mid-channel position keeps reef free of coastal runoff.

QA 2026-10-02. CORRECTION of 2026-07-03 note: Living Oceans Foundation (first-day-of-research page, fetched) DOES document Grid Iron: reef system seaward of the Narrows >10 km long, 5-10m, formerly flourishing elkhorn reef that mostly died ~30 years ago, perimeter with 3-5m lobate star coral colonies and mountainous star coral. That is a scientific description of the reef system, not necessarily the dive site. activecaribbeantravel: Atlantic side, 15-24m, 'diverse marine life'. Only 2 domains: validated set to false.

QA 2026-10-02 (5 domains). Anchors Away/Paradise Reef mooring sites with coral heads and swim-through canyons (dtmag); 'at least five identifiable anchors' (dtmag), 'half-dozen anchors' dropped by French/English/Spanish warships (afar), anchors left under cannon fire from Brimstone Hill fortress (dive-the-world); Sandy Point National Marine Park in the shadow of Brimstone Hill (afar). Depth 15-40m, angelfish/barracuda/turtles/eels/lobsters (activecaribbean). CONFLICT/FLAG: prodivers lists Paradise Reef in Old Road Bay and Sandy Point Reef as separate entries; mystkitts describes a shallow Sandy Point reef with variable visibility - names overlap, site identity unclear. REMOVED claim that this site 'combines' Paradise Reef and Anchors Away.

QA 2026-10-02 (4 domains). Southern tip, battered rock formation, fire coral, sponges, black sea urchins, occasional eagle rays, 30-60ft (prodivers); 6-24m, Atlantic meets Caribbean, rays (activecaribbean); 'St. Kitts' only drift dive... for experienced divers', strong currents (dtmag); Nag's Head North 15-60ft, southern stingrays, tarpon, brown chromis (divenevis). site_type changed wall -> drift: no source fresh this pass describes a wall; dtmag calls it a drift dive. REMOVED 'mini-wall' claim.

QA 2026-10-02 (3 domains; 'Coconut Tree Rocks' at prodivers/dive-the-world). Depth conflict: prodivers 40-80ft (12-24m); activecaribbean ~12m top with wall to 31m - kept 31. Fauna: small fish, grunts, snapper, groupers (prodivers, dive-the-world, activecaribbean); barracuda, spotted morays, lobsters, sand grottos (prodivers); eels, turtles, nurse sharks (activecaribbean). REMOVED species not re-confirmed: horse-eye jacks, blue runners, creole wrasse, rays; 'Coconut Shallows 11-24m' claim.

QA 2026-10-02. activecaribbean ('Devil's Caverns', Nevis): several swim-throughs, max 40ft/12m, corals, sea fans, tropical fish. liveaboard.com ('The Caves'): grottos with swim-throughs up to 40ft; barracuda, lobster, turtles, squirrelfish. villasofdistinction.com article (Devil's Caves, SW coast of Nevis, 17th-c. shipwreck remains, lists blacktip reef sharks/blue tangs) appears to paraphrase liveaboard.com - treated as non-independent and its extra claims not used. Frommer's HTTP 403. LOCATION CONFLICT: south tip (Frommer's, earlier note, unfetched) vs southwest coast (villas). Names differ across sources. <3 independent confirming domains: validated false.

Wikipedia only confirms the island's location (no diving content) - not counted. caribdiveguide.com returned empty content this pass so its details (parrotfish, porcupinefish, slipper lobsters, corallimorphs, flamingo tongues, coral head height) REMOVED as unverified.
